findings.title: Reseal the publication profile after changing its fixed input
findings.body: `checkedPublicationNativeValidation` treats `scripts/docs-publication-example-assets.mjs` as a fixed, byte-hashed input. The supplied profile still records its old SHA-256 (`d32279…`), while this bundle changes that file (`439ab9…`). Consequently, any qualifying publication validation that acquires this receipt fails at `fixed source/input scripts/docs-publication-example-assets.mjs` before the updated request validation can run. Update the independently maintained fixed-input/profile metadata as part of adopting this source change.

overall_explanation: The native request/template/provider/output validation is coherent, but the accompanying fixed-input publication guard is left inconsistent with the changed asset validator, making the relevant publication validation path fail closed.
